# invites.blog

> One link for a whole celebration: an animated invitation, the replies, and every photo the guests
> take. Hosts build personalised, role-aware invitations from a template gallery (or upload their
> own); guests open their link, reply, and add photos from the camera in the invitation or a QR code
> on the table, with no app.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](/pricing): free to make, share and collect replies, with 1 GB of photos for every event.
  A Party pass (MVR 199) or Wedding pass (MVR 699) is bought once for one big event. "Keep your
  photos" is MVR 150 a year. Studio (for designers and planners) and Venue (for resorts and halls)
  are monthly plans.

## Guest lists

- [Guest list guide](/guide/guest-list): how to format a guest list for upload (columns, required fields,
  common mistakes), with a [downloadable blank .xlsx template](/guest-list-template.xlsx).

## Help centre

- [Guides](/guide): step-by-step guides for organisers and guests — [your account](/guide/account),
  [creating an event](/guide/create-an-event), [animated invitations](/guide/animated-invitations),
  [your own design](/guide/your-own-design), [sharing and sending](/guide/sharing),
  [photo buckets](/guide/photo-buckets), [your feed](/guide/feed) and
  [people the event is for](/guide/celebrants).
